action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Liao Xinxi discovered that Jackson incorrectly handled the deserialization
of certain classes. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute
arbitrary code. (CVE-2017-7525)

It was discovered that the fix for CVE-2017-7525 was incomplete, as Jackson
still allowed the deserialization of certain dangerous classes. An attacker
could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2017-15095)

It was discovered that Jackson incorrectly handled XML external entities.
An attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information
or cause a denial of service. (CVE-2019-10172)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in Jackson.
